translationRepairs: In Jianade 2 (573) he was made pillar-of-state.
In Jiande 2 (573) he was made pillar-of-state.
s0062 has 建德二年; Jianade is a misspelling of the Northern Zhou reign name Jiande, and the proposed replacement is otherwise unchanged and accurate.
His grandfather Wen served as governor of Ji Province.
His great-grandfather Wen served as governor of Ji Province.
s0067 has 曾祖文, which is great-grandfather (generation three), not grandfather; the preceding 高祖寬 confirms the generational ladder, so great-grandfather is the correct repair.
Liang Yu — Guo Ganhui — Yi Feng — Liu Liang — Wang De
Liang Yu — Ruogan Hui — Yi Feng — Liu Liang — Wang De
s0001 names 若干惠; 若干 is the Xianbei compound surname Ruogan, so Guo Ganhui is a false English rendering and Ruogan Hui restores the supported name.
Guo Ganhui, styled Huibao, came from Wuchuan in Dai commandery.
Ruogan Hui, styled Huibao, came from Wuchuan in Dai commandery.
s0028 opens 若干惠字惠保; the surname is 若干 (Ruogan), not Guo, and the given name is 惠 (Hui), so Ruogan Hui is the accurate personal name.
Guo Ganhui and Wang De were famed for bold resolve, yet also lived by filial duty—no small thing.
Ruogan Hui and Wang De were famed for bold resolve, yet also lived by filial duty—no small thing.
s0155 abbreviates to 惠、德, referring to 若干惠 and 王德 from this chapter; replacing the false Guo Ganhui with Ruogan Hui corrects the naming while keeping the appraisal sense intact.
Gan Hui sighed to himself: "My parents are old—when will I be able to give them something like this?"
Ruogan Hui sighed to himself: "My mother is old—when will I be able to give her something like this?"

s0195 早喪父 shows his father was already dead, so s0197 親老矣 refers to the surviving mother, not plural parents; the proposed mother/her fix is right, but Gan Hui remains the false short form of Guo Ganhui and must be Ruogan Hui.
